raw_text: New satellite imagery from Maxar shows significant construction activity at PLA positions near Galwan Valley. At least 12 new prefabricated structures visible at Hot Springs sector since May 28. Vehicle staging area expanded with what appears to be Type 15 light tanks. This is consistent with pre-anniversary reinforcement patterns seen in 2022 and 2023.
clean_text: Maxar satellite imagery shows 12 new prefabricated structures at PLA positions near Galwan Valley and expanded vehicle staging area with Type 15 light tanks, consistent with pre-anniversary reinforcement patterns.
